CustomField.description: Lets respondents jump between pages by clicking the steps of a vertical stage indicator when Stages Mode is off. Uses the same navigation as Stages Mode, including saving stage records. Only applies when Stage Indicator Type is vertical; Stages Mode is always non-linear and ignores it.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Let respondents jump between pages by clicking the vertical stage indicator, without turning on Stages Mode. Requires Stage Indicator Type to be vertical; Stages Mode already allows free navigation, so this setting only matters when Stages Mode is off.
CustomField.label: Non-Linear Navigation
